text.en: Now: Down from the Mountain. Find the shrine stone at Woundstone Foot; Try something the world has never seen. The only way down is the cut in the rocks to the south. Below it is Woundstone Foot, where an old stone stands. Do anything you like to it: use what you hold on it, put something on it, or strike it. Whatever you try, the world will answer.
text.zh: 现在要：下山。找到伤石山麓的路碑；做一件世界从没见过的事。下山的路只有一条，是南边岩壁上的那道豁口。下面是伤石山麓，那里立着一块古老的路碑。对它做什么都可以：用手里的东西碰它，往上面放点东西，或者打它一下。不管你做什么，世界都会回应。

text.en: Now: Down from the Mountain. Find the shrine stone at Woundstone Foot; Try something the world has never seen. The only way down is the cut in the rocks to the south. Below it is Woundstone Foot, where an old stone stands. Do anything you like to it: use what you hold on it, put something on it, or strike it. Whatever you try, the world will answer.
text.zh: 现在要：下山。找到伤石山麓的路碑；做一件世界从没见过的事。下山的路只有一条，是南边岩壁上的那道豁口。下面是伤石山麓，那里立着一块古老的路碑。对它做什么都可以：用手里的东西碰它，往上面放点东西，或者打它一下。不管你做什么，世界都会回应。
